name: Zachariah
overview: Zachariah, son of Jeroboam and a descendant of the house of Jehu, briefly reigned over Israel in Samaria for six months, continuing the sinful practices established by Jeroboam son of Nebat. His reign marks the fulfillment of God's promise to Jehu that his descendants would rule for four generations, yet Zachariah's evil actions led to his assassination by Shallum. The Scripture highlights the brevity and wickedness of his rule, emphasizing the consequences of unrepentant sin within Israel's leadership.
